name: DCI Darwin 01 (DRW01)
notes: DCI Data Centers' ~A$80m Darwin 01 (DRW01) facility at the Darwin Technology Park, Wishart (Palmerston LGA) was expected to begin construction in early 2024 after the Land Development Corporation tendered civil works (Inligo, Aug 2023); directory sources list 10MW planned initial IT capacity with modular expansion. Current operational status not confirmed by an official DCI page at time of check, so status = construction and capacity = planned initial IT load.

name: Darwin Data Centre Park (Wishart Estate)
notes: The NT Government identified Wishart Estate (Palmerston LGA) for establishment of an initial Data Centre Park and ran an EOI process for serviced land for data centre construction; Invest NT's hyperscale data and AI centres page (updated Aug 2025) continues to market serviced land for data centre construction at Wishart Estate Digital Hub. Recorded as an official announced precinct/landbank initiative rather than a built facility; DCI Darwin 01 (separate record) is the concrete facility on this land.

name: NEXTDC B1 Brisbane
notes: NEXTDC official Brisbane page lists B1 Brisbane at 20 Wharf St, Brisbane City QLD 4000 (Brisbane LGA) as an operating colocation data centre with interconnection and cloud access; capacity not disclosed on the official page.

name: NEXTDC B2 Brisbane
notes: NEXTDC official page describes B2 Brisbane at 454 St Pauls Terrace, Fortitude Valley (Brisbane LGA) as a 12MW Tier IV certified data centre engineered for ultra-low-latency access to hyperscale cloud platforms. Capacity is the official 12MW figure.

name: Equinix BR1 Brisbane (formerly Metronode Brisbane 1)
notes: Equinix lists Brisbane among its Australian data centre markets; BR1 at 54-58 Alfred Street, Fortitude Valley (Brisbane LGA) was originally Metronode Brisbane 1, renamed after the 2018 Metronode acquisition, and is a carrier-neutral IBX colocation facility. Local channel sources also reference a newer BR2 in Brisbane (not separately confirmed on the official page at check time). Capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: CT Hosting Bundaberg Data Centre
notes: Regional web-hosting provider CT Hosting states it is putting the finishing touches on its own Bundaberg data centre to support local hosting/colocation (enterprise-grade infrastructure for the region, colocation and dedicated servers coming soon). Small local facility; status = construction/near-completion from the vendor's own page; capacity not disclosed and no independent corroboration found (grade C).

name: Edge Centres EC15 Cairns
notes: Edge Centres lists EC15 Cairns (21 Lake St, Cairns City QLD 4870, Cairns LGA) as one of its four operational Australian edge data centres (EC1 Grafton, EC14 Townsville, EC15 Cairns, EC21 Mackay) per Data Centre Magazine; Baxtel and the chamber-of-commerce listing confirm the Cairns City address. Capacity not disclosed.
